zh: 你对这个平台持看涨态度吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Do you think that in the next three to five years that will stay the same?
zh: 你认为在未来三到五年内会保持不变吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: I think it is actually kind of risky because the algorithm changes so much.
zh: 我认为实际上有点风险，因为算法变化太大了。

speaker: Unknown
en: You might do something that angers the powers that be and without anyone knowing, things might change for you in terms of your reach on X.
zh: 你可能会做一些让当权者生气的事，而且在没人知道的情况下，你在 X 上的触及面可能会发生变化。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so I think there's less transparency than Twitter 1.0.
zh: 所以我认为这不如 Twitter 1.0 透明。

speaker: Unknown
en: So it is a little risky, but I think the platform has so much staying power.
zh: 所以这有点冒险，但我认为这个平台有很强的持久力。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's really hard to replace.
zh: 它真的很难被替代。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can change the name, you can destroy the brand, and the platform will still be very valuable.
zh: 你可以改名，你可以摧毁这个品牌，而这个平台仍然会非常有价值。

speaker: Unknown
en: It is one of those things that I think there's no way you can avoid it.
zh: 它是那种我认为你无法避免的事情之一。

speaker: Unknown
en: Who are some CEOs or leaders that inspire you in terms of how they go direct that you've learned from looking at what they do?
zh: 有哪些 CEO 或领导者，在他们直接沟通的方式方面启发了你，你是通过观察他们的做法而学到的？

speaker: Unknown
en: Obviously, we were all, you know, in the school of biology, biology and Lulu.
zh: 显然，我们都在，你知道，Biology 学派，Biology 和 Lulu。

speaker: Unknown
en: We had this group in a pandemic.
zh: 我们在大流行期间有这个小组。

speaker: Unknown
en: What was it called?
zh: 它叫什么来着？

speaker: Unknown
en: DeGone Directed.
zh: DeGone Directed。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah, DeGone Directed.
zh: 对，DeGone Directed。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah, and so we kind of talked about strategies and kind of critiqued some of our approaches or other people's approaches.
zh: 对，所以我们某种程度上谈论了策略，并批评了我们要么其他人的方法。

speaker: Unknown
en: So that was very, very useful.
zh: 所以那非常有用。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think biology was kind of earlier this stuff.
zh: 我认为 Biology 在这方面算是比较早的。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think where I...
zh: 我认为我...

speaker: Unknown
en: My disagree with biology is that I don't think you should be antagonistic to reporters.
zh: 我与 Biology 的分歧在于，我不认为你应该对记者采取敌对态度。

speaker: Unknown
en: There's no reason to.
zh: 没有理由这样做。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can actually be friends with them and they can be positive towards you.
zh: 你其实可以和他们做朋友，他们可以对你持积极态度。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can help them out.
zh: 你可以帮助他们。

speaker: Unknown
en: They're just humans at the end of the day and they respond to incentives.
zh: 归根结底他们只是人类，他们对激励做出反应。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I think we've done pretty well in maintaining our relationships with...
zh: 我认为我们在维持与……的关系方面做得相当好

speaker: Unknown
en: And obviously Shernaz recently joined us and that up-leveled our game with reporters and more of that type of media.
zh: 显然 Shernaz 最近加入了我们，这提升了我们在记者和那类媒体方面的水平。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I think, but studying that is very important.
zh: 所以我认为，但研究那一点很重要。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think there's enough content out there to get started with.
zh: 我认为那里有足够的内容可以开始着手。

speaker: Unknown
en: But let's see, who else?
zh: 但是让我们看看，还有谁？

speaker: Unknown
en: You know, I think Satya's doing such a great job.
zh: 你知道，我认为 Satya 做得非常出色。

speaker: Unknown
en: What about what he's doing?
zh: 关于他正在做的事呢？

speaker: Unknown
en: I think it is much less tweet-length things, but he's able to put out very well-reasoned arguments that play into the zeitgeist in a very smart way and advance their point of view, like the essay he put out.
zh: 我认为这要少得多的是推文长度的内容，但他能够提出非常理性的论点，以一种非常聪明的方式契合时代精神，并推进他们的观点，就像他发表的那篇文章一样。

speaker: Unknown
en: Over the weekend, you got 20, 30 million views.
zh: 在周末，你获得了 2000、3000 万的浏览量。

speaker: Unknown
en: Very few assets kind of get that much attention.
zh: 很少有资产能获得那么多的关注。

speaker: Unknown
en: But it comes at a time where everyone is thinking about token costs.
zh: 但它出现在每个人都在思考 token 成本的时候。

speaker: Unknown
en: Everyone's thinking about, and this is important thing about going direct.
zh: 每个人都在思考，而这是关于直接沟通的重要一点。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can go direct and get zero views.
zh: 你可以直接沟通并获得零浏览量。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's really easy to not pay attention to you.
zh: 人们真的很容易不理睬你。

speaker: Unknown
en: You have to understand the meta.
zh: 你必须理解 meta。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I think that's the thing that's more time consuming than posting.
zh: 我认为那是比发布更耗时的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: Posting is not time consuming.
zh: 发布并不耗时。

speaker: Unknown
en: The thing that's time consuming is understanding what is the larger debate, because the way to go viral is to couch or dress up your argument, your worldview in the current conversation.
zh: 耗时的事情是理解更大的争论是什么，因为想要疯传的方式就是把你的论点、你的世界观包装进当前的对话中。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah.
zh: 对。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I thought that what Satya did with his essays is very much at the heart of what the discussion is today.
zh: 我认为 Satya 用他的文章所做的非常处于今天讨论的核心。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then he advanced the point of view of Microsoft.
zh: 然后他推进了 Microsoft 的观点。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah.
zh: 对。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think it's a good place to wrap.
zh: 我认为这是结束的好地方。

en: Please give it up for Amjad.
zh: 请把掌声送给 Amjad。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thank you.
zh: 谢谢。
